name: axis
purpose: A number line (give only x) or x/y axes with ticks. Put point, plot and arrow blocks inside it; they share its scale.

y.doc: [min, max] of y; leave it out for a number line

xlog.doc: x holds the log10 of a value (decades); the ticks show 1, 10, 100, 1k, and so on. A plot or point gives log10 of its x

blocks.doc: point, plot and arrow blocks only. An arrow shows a vector, a force or a velocity from one place to another
